title: WORKER_TERMINAL_OVERRIDE_DENIED — real variability finding
what_happened: In a repeated real-worker run (Round B) the attempt-1 worker CLAIMED "Implementierung geändert, Test grün (pass 2, fail 0)" but never persisted build-attempt-1.json and never changed src/avg.mjs on disk.
runtime_reaction: Deterministic VERIFY re-ran the real test, observed TEST_FAILURE:average empty array on attempt 1, found no strategy_delta for a further attempt, and the deterministic controller returned SPLIT (RETRY_DENIED_NO_STRATEGY_DELTA) with FIRST_BAD_BOUNDARY=VERIFY.
significance: Proves WORKER_TERMINAL_OVERRIDE=DENIED with real workers: a worker success claim never becomes a runtime decision. Also proves VERIFY is ground truth: worker self-reports are not verification.
